content.text: Skip to main content Real-time Highway Information for Drivers, 511 Virginia Email Print PDF vn Facebook vn LinkedIn vn Vimeo Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) 1401 East Broad Street Richmond, VA 23219 (804) 786-2801 Get Directions Contact Information Main (804) 786-2801 Toll-Free (800) 367-7623 Visit Website Visit Program vn Facebook vn Twitter Who We Are The 511 Virginia website provides road conditions (alerts, delays, & Incidents), trip planning, traffic cameras, commuting options, and weather conditions selected by zip code. 511 Virginia smartphone app is now available to meet the growing needs of information on mobile devices. Visit the website to download. 511 is a toll free phone service that gives you up-to-the-minute, accurate information about road conditions, traffic problems, highway construction projects, and more. It also provides information about alternative ways to travel (without a car) that can help you save money, reduce stress, and protect the environment. Live traffic cameras are updated in real time. Emergency road conditions are updated as soon as the Traffic Operations Centers or Virginia State Police learn of an incident. Other information, such as upcoming construction projects or transit schedule changes, is updated as soon as the VDOT Traffic Operations Centers are notified.
